rationale: No supported optimization fits this workflow without risking coverage or breaking valid runs. The workflow has no explicit dependency-installation steps (no npm ci/pip/mvn/cargo) that P-LIT-GHA-CACHE could target; actions/checkout already handles repository fetching. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because every matrix configuration (Win32/x64/Debug/Release/UWP/MinGW and variants) appears to be a required build outcome, and the workflow already sets fail-fast: false. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT lack representative successful-duration history (ci_history records only conclusions, no durations), and a fixed timeout could break slow valid Windows C++ builds. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is unsafe because shared CMake configuration, generators, and dependencies affect all build paths, so path-based trigger filtering could skip required checks. No other pattern's preconditions are met by the repository files or workflow.
